title: Whitespace-Filter WAF Bypass Ladder
learning_objectives: Explain why stripping spaces and tabs is not a sound defence against SQL injection
Reach a MySQL backend with zero 0x20 space bytes using /**/ comments, %0a newlines, and parentheses
Use a byte-echo debug oracle to confirm exactly what a request filter forwards
Chain a whitespace-free UNION SELECT to exfiltrate a row a filter tried to hide
flag_hint: /solve compares ?email to the hidden admin row's email (users where id=1); on an exact match it returns the flag read from the flag file, otherwise HTTP 403.
inspired_by: PortSwigger 'SQL injection with filter bypass' family + classic WAF whitespace-blacklist evasions (/**/ comments, %0a newlines, parentheses) documented in OWASP and sqlmap tamper scripts
